# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 宗# (link) + 山 mountain → *towering* range of mountains → *lofty*; *noble* → *respect*; *revere*; *worship* (← look up to something/someone).
嵬高也。从山宗聲。
As per 奇# (lean) + 山 mountain → mountainous headland → *cape*; *promontory*. Compare 埼 and 碕.
崑崙，山名。从山昆聲。《漢書》楊雄文通用昆侖。
As per 卒# (compact) + 山 mountain → mountain *peak* towering over a collection of lesser peaks → *high*.
崒，危高也。从山卒聲。
As per 隹# (exert downward pressure) + 山 mountain → *high/towering* cliff/precipice at which one squats for safety (compare the crouching figure as described in 危 and in 負).
大高也。从山隹聲。
厓 here a variant form of 圭# (cone-shaped) + 山 mountain → cone-shaped *cliff* → *precipice*.
高邊也。从屵圭聲。
崑崙也。从山侖聲。
As per 夌# as described in 陵 (stretch) + 山 mountain → *towering mountain* with long ridges → *tower*.
屈# bend + 山 mountain → *bend* to enter a mountainous *cavern* (compare 窟) → *high, rocky mountain* (with such a cavern).
山短高也。从山屈聲。
嶸也。从山青聲。
山，在鴈門。从山𩫖聲。
As per 金# (contain) + 山 mountain → rugged mountain (containing protruding boulders; compare 嵒) → *steep, rugged mountain*.
山之岑崟也。从山金聲。
爭# (long and thin) + 山 mountain → the long, thin ridge of a *steep* and rugged *mountain* → *high*.
As per 松# (open) + 山 mountain → *high mountain* range with wide open spaces between its peaks.

As per 朋# (spread in alignment) + 山 mountain → dirt spreading in alignment as a hill/mound collapses (compare 壞, 隨 and 圮) → *collapse*; *crumble*; *fall apart*; *break*; *destruction*; *demolition* → *decline*; *worsen*; *rout* (an enemy position).
崵山，在遼西。从山昜聲。一曰嵎鐵崵谷也。
山名。从山，稽省聲。奚氏避難特造此字，非古。

The lower element# is as per 甘 (contain) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → contain food in the cavity of the mouth. 嵌 adds 山 mountain → *gorge*; *depression*. *Inlay*; *fit into* and *embed* are borrowed meanings.
山深皃。从山，歁省聲。
山名。从山敄聲。
As per 禺# (curve) + 山 mountain → *mountain recess*.
封嵎之山，在吳楚之閒，汪芒之國。从山禺聲。
九嵏山，在馮翊谷口。从山㚇聲。
As per 風# (flutter) + 山 mountain → mist/haze fluttering about a mountain → *storm/tempest*; (refreshing) *mountain air*.
山名。从山，葻省聲。
A depiction of large rocks embedded in and protruding from a mountain *cliff* → *crag*; *rock*.
會稽山。一曰九江當嵞也。民以辛壬癸甲之日嫁娶。从屾余聲。《虞書》曰：“予娶嵞山。”
高也。从屵隹聲。
山 mountain + 高# high/tall → the long, curving and narrow ridges of a *towering* mountain → *volume*; *bulk*.
中岳，嵩高山也。从山从高，亦从松。韋昭《國語》注云：“古通用崇字。”
As per 鬼# (large and lumpy) + 山 mountain → *high, rocky mountain* (with protruding, rounded boulders; compare 崛); *rugged mountain* (compare 巍).
高不平也。从山鬼聲。凡嵬之屬皆从嵬。
As per 差# (irregular) + 山 mountain → craggy, irregularly shaped mountain → *rugged/craggy* → *steep mountain*.
山皃。从山𢀩聲。
參# (commingle) + 山 mountain → intricate conjunction of *mountain peaks*.
章# (rise) + 山 mountain → soaring *mountain peaks*.
As per 斬# (cut) + 山 mountain → *steep* (peak cut into a) mountain → *high*; *rugged*. Compare 巉.
山多小石也。从山敖聲。
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 山 mountain → *winding mountain path* → *steep and largely impassable*.
崩聲。从屵配聲。讀若費。
欽# revere + 山 mountain → *steep and high mountain* that inspires reverence.
尤高也。从山棧聲。
As per 粦# as described in 隣 (repeated series) + 山 mountain → *mountain range*.
嶙峋，深崖皃。从山粦聲。
登# rise + 山 mountain → *slope*; *path leading up a mountain*.
山之墮墮者。从山，从憜省聲。讀若相推落之憜。
喬# tall and limber + 山 mountain → *high mountain* with a curved peak.
山銳而高也。从山喬聲。古通用喬。
As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 山 mountain → tall, arching mountain → *towering mountain* (or other object).
焦嶢，山高皃。从山堯聲。
葛嶧山，在東海下邳。从山睪聲。《夏書》曰：“嶧陽孤桐。”
山多大石也。从山，學省聲。
As per 義# (blade-like) + 山 mountain → *steep mountain* with serrated ridges. Compare 峨.
As per 僉# (assemble) + 山 mountain → *high and steep*, *rugged* characteristics of an assemblage of mountain peaks .
九嶷山，舜所葬，在零陵營道。从山疑聲。
As per 榮# (curve about) + 山 mountain → curving range of *high mountains*.
崝嶸也。从山榮聲。
As per 領# (string of objects) + 山 mountain → string of peaks in a *mountain range* → *peak*.
山道也。从山領聲。
As per 與# (raise in unison) + 山 mountain → *island* (← mountain-like protrusion rising from a body of water).
㠀也。从山與聲。
As per 獄# (harsh) + 山 mountain → rugged, rocky *mountain* → *peak*.
東，岱；南，靃；西，華；北，恆；中，泰室。王者之所以巡狩所至。从山獄聲。
巀𡾦山，在馮翊池陽。从山𢧵聲。
周燕也。从隹，屮象其冠也。㕯聲。一曰蜀王望帝，婬其相妻，慙亡去，爲子巂鳥。故蜀人聞子巂鳴，皆起云“望帝”。
As per 戲# (hole in the ground) + 山 mountain → ravine/gorge (in a mountainous area) → *crack*; *gap* (← ravine/gorge); *hazardous* (← dangerous geographic feature). Also, *steep*.
As per 毚# (pile) + 山 mountain → *steep* and *rugged* mountain with ridges of uneven height → *high*. Compare 嶄.
A variant form of 巖.
魏# lofty; tower over + 山 mountain → *high*/*towering* mountain or mountain range. 巍 was devised to replace 魏.
高也。从嵬委聲。
As per 䜌# as described in 戀 (stretch) + 山 mountain → *mountain range*; *peak* (← stretch of mountain peaks).
山小而銳。从山䜌聲。
顚# top/peak + 山 mountain → (mountain) *summit*.
As per 嚴# (rugged side of a mountain) + 山 mountain → rugged *cliff* → *rock*; *crag*; *steep*; *precipitous*. 巖 was devised to replace 嚴 after 嚴 acquired its associated meanings.
岸也。从山嚴聲。
As per 獻# (be filled high) + 山 mountain → high, steep *mountain* → *peak*.
水流澮澮也。方百里爲巜，廣二尋，深二仞。凡巜之屬皆从巜。
A depiction of a curving *river* boring its way through the earth in linking distant points. Compare 河. In characters such as 巡 and 邕, 川 appears in the form 巛.
貫穿通流水也。《虞書》曰：“濬く巜，距川。”言深く巜之水會爲川也。凡川之屬皆从川。
A depiction of a flowing river that surrounds sandbars → *sandbar*; *sandbank* → *province*; *state* (← administrative units ← like objects in a greater entity ).
水中可居曰州，周遶其㫄，从重川。昔堯遭洪水，民居水中高土，或曰九州。《詩》曰：“在河之州。”一曰州，疇也。各疇其土而生之。
水廣也。从川亡聲。《易》曰：“包巟用馮河。”

巛 variant of 川# river + 辵 movement → move in the manner of a river that swirls about sandbanks (compare 州) → *circulate (about)* → *go round*; *surround*; *turn* → *go about*; *concern* (a subject); *think over*.
延行皃。从辵川聲。
The relevant seal inscription form shows chicks in a *nest* high in a tree (compare 喿 as described in 操) → *build a nest*; *lair*; *den*; (spider's) *web* → *hotbed*.
鳥在木上曰巢，在穴曰窠。从木，象形。凡巢之屬皆从巢。
毛巤也。象髮在囟上及毛髮巤巤之形。此與籒文子字同。
A depiction of a long hollow tube used as a tool both to pierce and to connect → *work*; *construct* (← work/construct using connecting pipes/tubes) → *artisan*; *specialist*; *skillful*.
巧飾也。象人有規榘也。與巫同意。凡工之屬皆从工。
The relevant seal inscription form is 工 work + a hand# → the *left* hand, aligned at an angle with the right hand in assisting a task.
手相左助也。从𠂇、工。凡左之屬皆从左。
丂# as described in 号 (extend then bend) + 工 work → a piece of work characterized by curved lines → *skill*; *ingenuity*.
技也。从工丂聲。
A depiction of a large/great framing square (carpenter's tool), with arms at distant ends → *ruler*; *large/huge* → *much/many*.
規巨也。从工，象手持之。

As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 从 a variant form of 從 (people in close formation) → circle of people connecting this world and the other world by calling up a procession of spirits → *sorcery*; *sibyl*; *shaman*; *medium* → *maiden in the service of a shrine*.
祝也。女能事無形，以舞降神者也。象人兩褎舞形。與工同意。古者巫咸初作巫。凡巫之屬皆从巫。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines 左# (aligned at an angle) + a rice plant → rice plants in irregular alignment → *inconsistent*; *difference* (← irregular) → *dispatch* (← send forth ← protrude) → *thrust*; *offer* (← dispatch). The verb さす bears many extended senses from the idea of "thrust," including *extend*; *stretch*; *insert*; *raise* (the hands); *put up*; *carry*; *hold*; and *wear*.
貳也。差不相值也。从左从𠂹。

A depiction of a primitive loom consisting of two sticks, between which threads are stretched or raised. In derivative characters, 己 suggests "arise." *Oneself*, *sixth in a series* and *sixth calendar sign* are borrowed meanings.
中宮也。象萬物辟藏詘形也。己承戊，象人腹。凡己之屬皆从己。
A depiction of a forked stick used as a plow. *Stop*, *quit*, *just*, *already* and *to a great degree* are borrowed meanings. Distinguish 已 from 己 and 巳.

A depiction of a fetus hanging heavily in the womb (compare 孕 and 胎, as well as 煕). *Snake* (as the *sixth sign of the Chinese zodiac*) and *9 A.M. to 11 A.M.* are borrowed meanings. Distinguish 巳 from 己 and 已. Note that the equation ( 巳 = snake) in the Chinese zodiac has given rise to the idea that 巳 was originally a depiction of a snake. However, among the twelve signs, only in the case of 亥 (boar) does the original signification of the character overlap with the corresponding creature in the zodiac.
巳也。四月，陽气巳出，陰气巳藏，萬物見，成文章，故巳爲蛇，象形。凡巳之屬皆从巳。

A depiction of a person spread flat on the ground (compare 匍) → *spread open*; *cling/stick to* (← cling/stick to the earth; compare 爬). The borrowed meaning *swirling design* is based on the resemblance between 巴 and the swirling patterns on an archer's elbow protectors ( ともえ) → *whirlpool*; *vortex*.
蟲也。或曰食象蛇。象形。凡巴之屬皆从巴。

廣𦣞也。从𦣞巳聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is a variant of 从# a variant form of 從 follow + 廾 pair of hands → arrange people so that they follow in close, circular formation (compare 遵). *Southeast* is a borrowed meaning. In derivative characters, 巽 is also written in the variant form seen on the right-hand side of 噀, 撰 and 饌.
具也。从丌𠨎聲。
A depiction of fine *cloth* draped about/over an object, the two ends of the cloth in neat alignment → *cloth wrapped about the head*. *Width* is a borrowed meaning.
佩巾也。从冂，丨象糸也。凡巾之屬皆从巾。
韠也。上古衣蔽前而已，巿以象之。天子朱巿，諸矦赤巿，大夫葱衡。从巾，象連帶之形。凡巿之屬皆从巿。
